tasks.title: Contract 1.8.0 defines private manual incidents and safe public projections
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Behavior bullets, Checks and Completion evidence; R1, R6, Contract fields, Counterexamples and Security impact. Add all constants, five schemas/types, four validators, six audit actions and exports. Enforce all five internal-state invariants and strict inputs without changing public ManualIncident validation, validator identity or WIRE_VERSION. Implement the descriptor-based guard and eight-field projection. Update the existing exact-export smoke assertion and include the new module in dist freshness checks; rebuild committed dist; version 1.8.0.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail in the focused tests (coverage exit status is not the acceptance gate): every R1 state has a good record, each invariant 1-5 rejects a bad one, strict inputs reject unknown keys, the six audit actions require manual-incident kind, projection strips all private and unknown update fields. R6 counterexamples give literal true/false as specified; getters on either privacy key return false with 0 calls, inherited keys count as absent, throwing and revoked proxies give false without throwing.

exit 0; lint, build, typecheck and the complete suite pass with the existing 0.8 coverage threshold; every new type compiles in test/types.fixture.ts and the package-entry smoke test accepts the additive exports. WIRE_VERSION stays 1 and existing public validators preserve their behavior.
exit 0 after committing the rebuilt dist and rerunning bun run check, matching the repository CI freshness check.

PR body records the pre-change main SHA and new tests failing there and passing on the branch, bun run check result, committed dist and type-fixture evidence, and the applicable Security impact checklist: descriptor/accessor safety, strict validation, limits, and secret-free errors. No new runtime dependency.
